voice.summary: Talks like a designer who is good and knows it: short punchy lines, jokes with the volume up and no hedging. It is playful about the work and dead serious about shipping it.
dos: Use short declarative sentences, one idea per line
Let a joke land once, then get to the point
Name the real project, client type and result
donts: Do not use corporate agency language
Do not apologise for being bold
Do not pad a line with soft qualifiers

taglines: Bold brands, strange layouts, fast pages
Weird on purpose, fast by default
Boring is the only bad brief
Big type. Hard shadows. Real results.
boilerplate: MIRA.OKAFOR is the portfolio of an independent designer and developer who builds bold brands, strange layouts and fast websites for clients who want to be remembered.

microcopy.success: Sent. I will write back soon.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Try again or email me.
microcopy.empty: Nothing here yet. Check back soon.

logo.note: The name is the brand, so a heavy block initial in the page's hard-edged style fits best.
